scope: Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) facility context and the ePIC experiment, from public documents only. Facility material (beam species, polarization, collision configurations as design targets, interaction region) and experiment material (ePIC detector concept, software and data-format entry points) are kept in separate modules with separate scopes. Documentation only: no performance numbers beyond the cited claims, no datasets, no calibration constants, no runnable experiment software.
exclusions: Other EIC detector concepts and proposals (a second-IR detector, earlier proposals) unless a module names them with a source

ePIC internal documents, unpublished performance numbers, calibration constants, production campaigns, analysis cuts and generated samples: project configuration or a local profile, never this profile
Any specific ePIC software release or data-format version not named in the evidence ledger; no executable support is claimed
Measured EIC beam or detector performance: every beam number here is a design target and every detector number a design value unless its claim says otherwise
Datasets: no EIC data exist to record; HERA or other collider practice is never presented as EIC or ePIC practice
maintainer: hchouTW (public-document profile; not endorsed by the EIC project, BNL, Jefferson Lab or the ePIC Collaboration)

capabilities.name: facility-and-detector-context
capabilities.scope: Text modules for EIC facility context and the ePIC detector concept, every factual bullet tied to a ledger claim; guidance, not executable checks and not detector performance

capabilities.name: evidence-ledger
capabilities.scope: Structural validity of the eic ledger (ids, levels, dates, claim-to-source strength, index sync, module citations); not the truth of any claim

capabilities.name: routing-scenarios
capabilities.scope: Generic-DIS, EIC-facility, ePIC-detector, ambiguous-detector and unrelated-experiment requests resolve to the expected decision and resource files through contracts/project.py and index.md; static, no model call

capabilities.name: software-execution
capabilities.scope: No ePIC software (eic-shell, EICrecon, the epic geometry, EDM4eic) is installed, built or run by this plugin; the software module documents entry points only, with no release pinned
